theater: 朝鮮半島北部浿水、玄菟一線

battle.name: 漢滅衛氏朝鮮之戰
battle.theater: 朝鮮半島北部浿水、玄菟一線
battle.brief: 前109年，衛氏朝鮮攻入玄菟、殺害漢使，漢武帝遣樓船將軍楊僕、左將軍衛奇率五萬人自齊國渡海反攻；水軍失利後改走陸路，攻破浿水沿岸諸城，殺大將左渠盜，迫國王負芻出降，翌年置樂浪等四郡。卡面亞述長矛屬前900年前的兩河兵器，不在此役現場；朝鮮用弓、矛、盾與銅戈，漢軍用弩、鐵矛與樓船。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 這場戰爭是西漢中央對半島北部衛氏朝鮮的一次大規模用兵，發生在漢武帝元封二年至三年（公元前109至前108年），戰場橫跨今朝鮮半島北部由玄菟到王險的海岸與河谷。漢朝一方是以五萬人為額的遠征大軍：樓船將軍楊僕率水軍，統帥由樓船、艨艟、戈船組成的大小船隊，船上備弩、弓與矛，配齊卒；左將軍衛奇率騎兵與步卒，負責陸路；涉何等使節官員隨軍引路與宣撫。部隊自齊國臨淄、黃縣一線集結，經登州、芝罘出海，渡海指向浿水。漢廷的目標不僅是懲罰，而是要把半島北部的土地正式改造成郡縣，戰前已有樂浪、玄菟、臨屯、真番四郡的籌劃。朝鮮一方是衛氏朝鮮王國，公元前194年燕人衛滿東出後建立，以王險（今平壤一帶）為都，國王負芻之下有以左渠盜為首的軍事首腦，玄菟與浿水沿岸是其北面屏障。兩國此前百餘年維持朝貢與屬國關係，漢廷視朝鮮為臣屬，視其攻掠玄菟、殺害漢使為叛逆。第三方並非中立國，而是被戰事捲入的方國與部落：真番在玄菟以北，辰韓在半島南部，樂浪郡界內尚有不肯編戶的小部族；它們在漢軍到來時或附或叛，使戰局並非單純的兩軍對撞。
countriesEn: This war was a large-scale campaign by the Western Han against the kingdom of Gojoseon in the northern part of the Korean peninsula, fought in the second and third years of Yuanfeng (109 to 108 BC) under Emperor Wu of Han, with the theatre running along the coast and the river valleys of northern Korea from Xuantu to Wangxian. The Han side was a far-ranging army of fifty thousand: a fleet under the loouchuan jiangjun Yang Pu, made up of large loouchuan vessels together with mengchong and ge ships, manned with crossbowmen, archers and spearmen, and a left jiangjun, Wei Qi, with cavalry and infantry for the land route, plus envoys such as She He to guide the columns and to proclaim the court's message. The forces mustered in the Qi commandery, along the belt around Linzi and Huangxian, and went out to sea from Dengzhou and Zhifu to strike across the water at the Taedong. The court's aim was not merely to punish but to turn the northern peninsula into commanderies and counties; the plan for the four districts of Lelang, Xuantu, Lintun and Zhenfan had been drawn up before the fighting began. On the Korean side stood the kingdom of Gojoseon, founded in 194 BC by Wei Man, a man of Yan, who had fled east beyond the frontier; its capital was Wangxian, the area of Pyongyang today, and beneath the king Fuchu stood a military leadership headed by the commander Zuo Qudao, while Xuantu and the banks of the Taedong formed its northern shield. For more than a century the two had kept a relationship of tribute and vassalage, the court treating Gojoseon as a subject state and regarding its raids and the killing of an envoy as rebellion. The third parties were not neutral states but principalities and peoples drawn into the fighting: Zhenfan lay north of Xuantu, Mahan lay in the south of the peninsula, and small groups inside the future Lelang area refused to be registered as households; they attached themselves to the Han or to the Koreans as the tide turned, so that the campaign was never a simple collision of two armies.
people: 關鍵人物分在漢廷、朝鮮與記錄三處。漢武帝劉徹是決策者：他在前111年剛平南越、置南海諸郡，元封二年（前109年）聽聞朝鮮攻玄菟、殺漢使而震怒，遂決心用兵，此役的戰略目標是把漢朝的東北邊界從遼水推到浿水，使節涉何是導火線：奉命赴朝鮮交涉，遭冷遇，其隨從鄣時為朝鮮所殺，涉何逃回上奏，漢廷因此把朝鮮由「不敬」的屬國改列為「叛」的一邊。樓船將軍楊僕是水軍統帥，他此前以伏波將軍平定南越，本役轉領樓船，以艦隊直取浿水；左將軍衛奇率騎兵走陸路，兩軍在王險城下會合，構成漢軍在半島上的鉗形攻勢。朝鮮一方，國王負芻是決定降與不降的人：戰局崩壞後出亡，再遣使請降，漢廷隨後封他為平陽侯；大將左渠盜則是抵抗的象徵，率兵在浿水一線死守，兵敗被殺，其死使朝鮮軍心瓦解。衛氏朝鮮的開國者衛滿是燕人，這層出身說明這個王國與漢初邊地豪族的關係；而記錄此役的司馬遷在《史記·朝鮮列傳》中留下的文字，是今日重建此役的唯一主幹。
peopleEn: The key figures lie in three places: the Han court, the Korean court, and the record. Emperor Wu of Han, Liu Che, was the decision-maker: only two years earlier, in 111 BC, he had conquered Nanyue and set up its commanderies, and when he heard in the second year of Yuanfeng (109 BC) that Gojoseon had attacked Xuantu and killed Han envoys, he was incensed and resolved on war; the strategic purpose of the campaign was to push the Han frontier from the Liao River forward to the Taedong, so that the northern peninsula would come inside the orbit of Han administration. The envoy She He was the fuse: sent to Gojoseon to remonstrate, he was met with contempt, his attendant Zhang Shi was killed by the Koreans, and She He fled back to report it, so that the court turned Gojoseon from an impolite vassal into a rebel. Yang Pu, the loouchuan jiangjun, commanded the fleet; having won his earlier renown as the fubo jiangjun who conquered Nanyue, he now brought the great ships to bear directly on the Taedong. Wei Qi, the left jiangjun, led the cavalry and the foot on the land route, and the two forces joined before the walls of Wangxian, forming the pincers of the Han on the peninsula. On the Korean side the king Fuchu was the man who decided whether to surrender; once the position collapsed he fled, then sent an envoy to ask for terms, and the court afterwards enfeoffed him as marquis of Pingyang. The commander Zuo Qudao was the emblem of resistance, holding the line on the Taedong with his troops and being killed when it failed, and his death broke the morale of the Korean army. The founder of the dynasty, Wei Man, was a man of Yan, which tells us about the ties of this kingdom to the frontier magnates of early Han; and the text that records the war, the liezhuan on Korea in the Shiji, was written by Sima Qian, and it is the only main trunk from which the campaign can now be reconstructed.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是亞述王國的近身長兵器：短柄、長刃、配鐵鏃，柄與刃的比例讓它既可推刺又可揮砍，亞述人把它和弓、斧、鐵劍編在同一套裝備裡，靠密集的矛列與箭雨解決攻城與野戰；它成型於前900年前後的亞述帝國，到公元前109年已過去一千餘年，朝鮮半島不可能出現這種武器，本役交手的完全是另一套東西。朝鮮的兵器以弓矢與矛戈為主：弓是這一地區最有效也最常見的殺傷手段，矢鏃多為鐵或骨，弓臂用木與角；長兵器有矛、有戈，形制與裝飾帶有明顯的中原青銅傳統，銅戈、銅矛、銅斧上的銘文常見「王」字一類的族徽，與先秦銅器同一系統；防護以皮甲、木札甲和木盾為主，金屬甲胄稀少。漢軍那邊是鐵器與弩的世界：環首刀、鐵矛鐵鏃、戟、劍，配蹶張弩、黃弩與臂弓的階梯射擊，護具以札甲、皮甲為主，另有大型木盾與竹木盾；水軍船上載弩手與持矛的齊卒，樓船設樓，艨艟、戈船各司其用。戰馬已入軍，朝鮮弓馬之風在漢軍騎兵身上同樣體現，樂浪郡一帶出土的馬具與弓弩零件說明兩軍都已把馬與投射武器結合起來作戰。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is the close-combat long weapon of the Assyrian kingdom: a short haft, a long blade, an iron head, the proportion of shaft to blade allowing both thrust and swing, which the Assyrians assigned together with the bow, the axe and the iron sword, resolving sieges and field battles with dense spear lines and showers of arrows. It belongs to the Assyrian empire of roughly 900 BC; by 109 BC more than a thousand years had passed, so such a weapon could not have appeared on the Korean peninsula, and what actually met here was an entirely different order of arms. The Korean weapons were centred on the bow and the spear: the bow was the most effective and most common means of killing in this region, with iron or bone arrowheads and a bow of wood and horn; the polearms were the spear and the ge, whose form and decoration carry a clear Central Plains bronze tradition, bronze gous, bronze maos and bronze axes inscribed with clan marks of the kind written with the character for king, belonging to the same system as pre-Qin bronzes; protection was by leather armour, wooden lamellar armour and wooden shields, and metal body armour was scarce. On the Han side the world was one of iron and of the crossbow: ring-pommel sabres, iron spearheads, halberds and swords, with the tiered shooting of the drawn crossbow, of the yellow crossbow and of the arm bow, body protection of lamellar and of leather armour, and large wooden and bamboo shields; the ships carried crossbowmen and spearmen on the decks, the loouchuan rose in tiers, and the mengchong and the ge ship each had their own use. The warhorse was already in service, and the fame of Korean archery and riding showed just as much in the Han cavalry; the horse gear and the crossbow parts excavated around the future Lelang area show that both armies already fought with the horse and the missile weapon combined.
tactics: 漢軍的打法分三段。第一段是「先問後打」：涉何奉使命朝鮮交涉失敗、鄣時為朝鮮所殺，朝廷以此為辭出師，戰前在齊國沿海集結、編組水陸兩軍，說明漢廷仍循「先遣使誡諭、喻以利害」的舊例。第二段是海路突進與轉陸：楊僕的水軍自芝罘出海，渡渤海直趨浿水，試圖以艦隊的弩壓制把朝鮮海防逼出來；然而朝鮮軍依托近岸山灣與礁岸夜襲漢船，漢軍水戰失利、舟楫焚毀，楊僕只得放棄海上正面，率殘部登岸改走沿海陸路北上，漢軍由「直取」轉為「沿海岸線強行展開」，這是本役最關鍵的戰術轉折。第三段是水陸夾擊、攻破國都：衛奇的騎兵與步兵沿陸路掃清玄菟、浿水一線的堡壘，楊僕的殘餘舟師則沿海策應，兩軍合兵攻破浿水右岸要邑、殺死左渠盜，隨即直抵王險城下，斷絕朝鮮王西逃與南撤的路線。朝鮮軍在攻守之間節節失據：憑城固守可以拖住腳步，卻無法挽回水陸兩面同時受壓的局面；一旦左渠盜陣亡、國都門戶被突破，城內即出現投降的管道。最後，負芻出亡之後再遣使降，漢軍入城，整場戰爭以「破國都而不屠城」收束。
tacticsEn: The Han method ran in three movements. The first was to ask before striking: She He was sent to remonstrate and failed, his attendant Zhang Shi was killed, and the court used that as the stated ground for the war; the troops mustered and were organised into a water force and a land force on the Qi coast beforehand, which shows that the court still followed the old pattern of admonishing first and only then using force. The second movement was the dash by sea and the turning inland: Yang Pu's fleet put out from Zhifu, crossed the Bohai and struck straight at the mouth of the Taedong, hoping that the crossbows of the ships would press the Korean coastal defence out of the way; but the Korean troops, holding the night-bay and the rocky shore close inshore, fell upon the Han boats, the water battle was lost and the hulls were burnt, and Yang Pu had to give up the frontal attack from the sea, land his remnant and push north along the coast on foot, so that the Han changed from a direct thrust into a forcible deployment along the shoreline — the decisive tactical turning of the campaign. The third movement was the joint assault by land and sea and the storming of the capital: Wei Qi's cavalry and foot swept the forts along Xuantu and the Taedong, Yang Pu's surviving flotilla supported them from the sea, the two forces combined to break the strong places on the right bank of the Taedong and killed Zuo Qudao, and then drove straight to the walls of Wangxian, cutting off the king's road west and south. The Korean army lost ground step by step between holding and being attacked: the walls could delay the advance but could not repair a position pressed from the sea and the land at once; once Zuo Qudao had fallen and the gate of the capital was broken, the pipe of surrender opened inside the walls. In the end Fuchu fled and then sent in an envoy to surrender, the Han entered the city, and the war closed with the capital taken and the city not put to the sack.
data: 可考的數字大致如下。時間：漢武帝元封二年（公元前109年）朝鮮攻玄菟、殺漢使，元封三年（公元前108年）夏漢軍出海，同年朝鮮降、置郡。兵力：漢軍五萬人，《史記·朝鮮列傳》與《漢書·朝鮮傳》都記作「將五萬人」，是本役唯一確切的數字；朝鮮方面的兵力史籍不載，只記其「悉國兵」出戰。舟船：楊僕以樓船將軍領水軍，樓船、艨艟、戈船各數十艘的編制見於漢代水軍通例，實際數目無從確指。距離：自齊國芝罘（今山東蓬萊）浮海至浿水口，航程約六百至七百公里；玄菟（今黃海道、咸鏡道一帶）至王險（今平壤）陸路約二百公里，漢軍自登陸到破都，按當時行程推約一個多月。郡縣：《漢書·地理志》記樂浪郡戶六萬餘、口三十五萬餘，屬幽州，郡治在朝鮮縣（今平壤），管縣七；玄菟郡同屬幽州，縣分置沃沮、候井一帶；臨屯、真番兩郡與樂浪同批設置，其後真番郡旋廢，臨屯郡於始元五年併入樂浪。器物：樂浪郡治遺址與平壤一帶出土的漢式鐵器（環首刀、鐵矛、鐵鏃）、木簡、瓦當與五銖、半兩錢，是本役之後漢式器物進入半島的直接證據。月份：出兵的具體月份在傳世史籍中沒有留下記載，卡面取七月，取漢軍在元封三年夏季用兵的常例；能確定的只是戰役始於元封二年冬春之際、翌年夏漢軍主力抵達浿水。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. Date: in the second year of Yuanfeng (109 BC) Gojoseon attacked Xuantu and killed a Han envoy; in the third year (108 BC), in the summer, the Han fleet put out to sea; in the same year Gojoseon surrendered and the commanderies were set up. Strength: the Han army numbered fifty thousand, a figure given identically in the liezhuan on Korea in the Shiji and in the account of Korea in the Hanshu, and the only exact number belonging to the campaign; the Korean numbers are not recorded, the histories say only that the whole army of the country was brought out. Ships: Yang Pu led the fleet as loouchuan jiangjun, with loouchuan, mengchong and ge ships formed up in the usual Han naval fashion, but no actual figure for their numbers can be fixed. Distance: from Zhifu in Qi, the present-day Penglai in Shandong, to the mouth of the Taedong is a passage of roughly six to seven hundred kilometres; the land road from Xuantu, the area of the present-day Hwanghae and Hamgyong provinces, to Wangxian, modern Pyongyang, is about two hundred kilometres, and at the pace of the marches of the time it took the Han a little over a month from landing to the fall of the capital. Commanderies: the Hanshu Dizhi records Lelang with some sixty thousand households and more than three hundred and fifty thousand people, under Youzhou, with its seat in the county of Korea, modern Pyongyang, over seven counties; Xuantu likewise belonged to Youzhou, its counties including Wuju and Houjing; Lintun and Zhenfan were established in the same batch, Zhenfan was soon abolished, and Lintun was merged into Lelang in the fifth year of Shiyuan. Objects: Han ironwork recovered at the site of the Lelang commandery seat and around Pyongyang — ring-pommel sabres, iron spearheads and arrowheads — together with wooden tablets, roof-tile ends, and wuzhu and banliang coins, is the direct evidence for the flow of Han objects into the peninsula after the war. Month: the precise month of departure is not preserved in the transmitted histories; the card takes July, following the regular pattern of Han campaigning in the summer of the third year of Yuanfeng; all that can be fixed is that the war began in the winter and spring of the second year, and that the main Han force reached the Taedong in the summer following.
cause: 這場戰爭不是漢朝預謀的開疆之作，而是一次邊界摩擦升級成的討伐。漢朝對朝鮮的關係由來是「屬國」式的：自衛滿受漢高祖封為朝鮮王，歷四代王，朝鮮向漢廷朝貢、漢廷偶有賞賜，彼此相安；但漢廷的邊疆政策在武帝一朝整體收緊——前127年置朔方郡、前121年奪河西四郡、前111年平南越置七郡，每一處新郡都把漢朝的實際控制線往外推，朝鮮正卡在這條線的東端。直接引爆的是元封二年（前109年）朝鮮的北進：它攻入玄菟、殺傷漢朝邊吏與使者，把漢的屬國變成了漢的敵人；接著涉何奉命前往交涉，卻遭冷遇並失去隨從鄣時，朝議遂認定朝鮮「不敬」已至於叛。內因則是朝鮮自身的生存壓力：北面有真番等部族擾邊，東面已漸失控制，而漢朝在南越與西域的成功使其邊境秩序被視為可以挑戰；加之郡縣化改制的籌劃（樂浪等郡的設想已傳到半島），在王險與玄菟之間形成了一個「誰來收稅、誰來徵兵」的空白。於是雙方都別無選擇：漢廷不能容忍屬國殺使而毫無反應，朝鮮王也不能在北線失守時放棄玄菟這道門戶。
causeEn: This war was not a planned Han conquest but a border friction that escalated into a punitive expedition. Han relations with Gojoseon had always been of the vassal kind: since Wei Man was enfeoffed as king of Korea by the founder of the Han, four generations of kings had sent tribute to the court and received favours in return, and the two had lived in peace; but the frontier policy of the court tightened across the whole of the reign of Wu — the commandery of Shuofang was set up in 127 BC, the four commanderies of Hexi were taken in 121 BC, and Nanyue was conquered and seven commanderies established in 111 BC, each new commandery pushing the line of actual control further out, and Gojoseon sat exactly on the eastern end of that line. What ignited it was the northern push of Gojoseon in the second year of Yuanfeng (109 BC): it broke into Xuantu and killed Han frontier officials and envoys, turning a Han vassal into a Han enemy; then, when She He was sent to remonstrate, he was met with contempt and lost his attendant Zhang Shi, and the court judged that the disrespect of Gojoseon had reached the point of rebellion. The internal cause was the pressure on Gojoseon itself: northern peoples such as Zhenfan harried its border, its control of the east was already loosening, and the Han successes in Nanyue and further west made its frontier order look open to challenge; and the plan to turn the peninsula into commanderies — the scheme for Lelang and its companions had already reached the peninsula — left between Wangxian and Xuantu a vacuum over who would levy the tax and who would call up the men. So neither side had a choice: the court could not let a vassal kill an envoy and do nothing, and the king of Gojoseon could not abandon the gate of Xuantu while the northern line was failing.
impact: 此役的後果遠超一場邊境討伐。衛氏朝鮮作為獨立王國在公元前108年終結，漢朝第一次直接控制半島北部，其留下的不是戰俘而是一整套制度：樂浪郡的郡縣、鄉里與戶口編制，漢式鐵器、銅鏡、漆器、瓦當與五銖錢的大批流入，以及樂浪郡治遺址出土的漢代木簡，把漢朝的家國治理搬到了王險城下，半島北部此後數百年被納入中原王朝的編戶體系。經濟上，樂浪郡是漢朝在東北的門戶，郡內屯田、馬政與海上交通隨郡治一同建立，直到東漢仍有樂浪、玄菟、帶方的北方郡縣網與山海道航線。軍事與戰略上，漢朝在玄菟與浿水一線取得的地形，成為後來高句麗南下的天然跳板；同一區域在百餘年後也成為樂浪郡反覆易手、昭帝時一度罷郡而後復置的舞臺，可見這道邊界從來算不得安穩。文化上，這是鐵器、馬與弓弩技術一次成規模的南下，朝鮮弓馬的傳統此後在中世半島國家手中發揚；而漢人在半島留下的郡學、漢式墓葬與隨葬品，又成為三國至統一新羅時期漢文化在半島的物質底層。
impactEn: The consequences of this campaign reached far beyond a frontier punitive expedition. Gojoseon as an independent kingdom ended in 108 BC, and for the first time the Han held the northern peninsula directly; what they left behind was not prisoners of war but an entire system: the commanderies, the villages and the household registration of Lelang, the great inflow of Han iron, bronze mirrors, lacquerware, roof-tile ends and wuzhu coin, and the Han wooden tablets excavated at the seat of Lelang — all of it carried the government of the Han state to the walls of Wangxian and drew the northern peninsula into the registered-household system of the Chinese dynasties for centuries. In economic terms Lelang was the Han gateway to the north-east, and the commandery brought with it settlement farms, horse administration and a sea route; through the Eastern Han the northern network of commanderies and the coastal sailing line of Lelang, Xuantu and Daifang continued to function. In military and strategic terms, the ground the Han took along Xuantu and the Taedong became a natural springboard for the later southward advance of Goguryeo; the same area a century afterwards was the stage on which Lelang changed hands again and was briefly withdrawn and then restored under Emperor Zhao, which shows that this frontier was never a settled one. In cultural terms this was a wholesale southward transfer of iron, of the horse and of bow and crossbow technique, and the Korean tradition of archery and riding was afterwards carried to its height by the medieval states of the peninsula; while the schools, the Han-style burials and the grave goods the Han left behind became the material base on which Han culture stood in the peninsula in the Three Kingdoms and the Unified Silla periods.
result: 公元前108年的結局，是衛氏朝鮮國破、漢朝立郡。漢軍在初戰水戰失利後改走陸路，攻破浿水一線的城邑，殺死左渠盜，進逼王險；朝鮮王負芻出亡，既不能整軍再戰，也無力分兵守禦，最終遣使降漢，漢廷封他為平陽侯，其國除為郡縣。樂浪郡以朝鮮縣（今平壤）為治，與玄菟、臨屯、真番同批設置，由漢官鎮守，舊日的王險城從王國首都變成郡治與軍鎮；四大軍中，楊僕的水軍與衛奇的騎兵在戰後被裁撤或調回，涉何以引路之功獲賞，漢朝隨後在樂浪置郡吏、發兵戍守、編戶齊民。可以確定的是，公元前109年之後，漢朝的國界第一次落在浿水之南，半島北部第一次有了郡縣；不能確定的是這套秩序能維持多久——樂浪郡在昭帝時一度罷撤、真番郡旋即廢除、臨屯郡後來併入樂浪，舊貴族與北方部族的反抗此起彼伏，說明這場戰爭打下的是一個開端，不是一個終局。
resultEn: The outcome in 108 BC was the breaking of the state of Gojoseon and the planting of Han commanderies. After the Han lost the water fight they turned to the land road, broke the towns along the Taedong, killed Zuo Qudao and pressed on to Wangxian; the king Fuchu fled, unable to regroup for battle or to split his forces to hold the passes, and finally sent an envoy to surrender, whereupon the court enfeoffed him as marquis of Pingyang and his country was converted into commanderies. Lelang was established with its seat at the county of Korea, modern Pyongyang, together with Xuantu, Lintun and Zhenfan, and held by Han officials: the old capital of Wangxian changed from the seat of a kingdom into the seat of a commandery and a garrison town. Of the Han columns, the fleet of Yang Pu and the cavalry of Wei Qi were disbanded or transferred after the war; She He was rewarded for the service of guiding the army; and the court went on to appoint commandery officials at Lelang, to post troops there and to register the households and to equalise the tax. What can be fixed is that after 109 BC the Han frontier lay for the first time south of the Taedong, and that the northern peninsula had a commandery for the first time; what cannot be fixed is how long that order held. Lelang was withdrawn for a time under Emperor Zhao, Zhenfan was abolished almost at once, Lintun was later merged into Lelang, and the resistance of the old aristocracy and of the northern peoples rose and fell in turn, which shows that this war won a beginning rather than an end.
